player_prompt.intro:
Yaa ngone jàngoro {player_id} jàng {colour} ({piece}) ci xeexu Othello.
Waxad jeem a amee lu bari piece yu ndaw yu mel ne saa ci tablo bi ci njëlbeen gi.
Ci tuurnu la, tab ci piece beneen ngir mu ñëw ci biiru piece yu saa opponent yi ciy direction yu bari (wojyu, kaw-kaw, mbaa diagonal) ci diggante piece bu saa bu bees bi ak beneen bu saa bu amoon. Piece yu opponent yi ñëw ci saa lañuy dale.
Indil saa move ci format '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Amul benn doxalin bu am solo - mën nga koo bàyyi.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Amul benn doxalin bu am solo. Yéen mën ngeen a bàyyi ko ci suuf.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Jëf bi war na nekk ci melokaanu [row, col].

game_action.skipped: Jëfandikukat {pid} dafa wara wéy ci seen wàll.

game_message.must_skip: Jàngoro {pid} ({piece}) amul digg yu am solo wara skip.
